capabilities: mark selected text with a priority level
increase or decrease the priority of selected text
remove a previously set priority level
configure the number and names of priority levels
create, apply, overwrite and delete priority presets
extras: README includes optional developer setup (building from source, ESLint) but no screenshots or usage examples.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assign and adjust priority levels to tasks or notes.
summary: Task and note prioritizer that marks selected text with configurable priority levels via commands, hotkeys, and saved presets.
